dev_selection: same first128 source validation rows as stage0 CFM
normalization: re-standardize selected x using regression fit subset only; source profiles retain frozen per-row minmax; no target data
residuals: held-out source calibration curves minus source fitted conditional mean; draw whole168h two-channel residual from one region, fixed paired indices across alpha/views
permutation_control: shuffle fit-label rows only, preserving each complete two-channel curve; calibration keeps true paired source residuals; this diagnoses dependence of this regression on fitted relationships, not a claim of all source information removal
selection: minimum source dev sampleCRPS separately by channel and feature view; ties smaller alpha; results are selected dev estimates, not generalization tests
uncertainty: 128 correlated source regions, one predetermined empirical Monte Carlo draw set, no independent-city CI
model_identity: ordinary Ridge and residual resampling, no novelty claim
